_meta.method: Web research on Bodhi Zendo (Sanbo Zen, Tamil Nadu) and AMA Samy lineage.
_meta.coverageEstimate: High for the principal standing Zen monastery in India (Bodhi Zendo). Low for other lineages.
knownGaps: No standing Plum Village monastery in India verified; Plum Village India activity is limited to occasional retreats and lay sanghas.
Buddha-vacana Zen India referenced in brief not located via sourced URL.
No Sotoshu-listed Soto Zen temple in India found in official directory.

Groups trading as 'Zen' in Mumbai and Bangalore (Samurai Zen, and various Meetup circles) are secular mindfulness or martial-arts businesses with no Zen Buddhist lineage or transmission, and are deliberately excluded — 2026-08-13.

places.name: Bodhi Zendo
places.address: Bodhi Zendo, Perumalmalai, Kodaikanal Hills, Dindigul District, Tamil Nadu 624212, India
places.notes: Sanbo Zen monastery founded 1996 by AMA Samy (Yamada Koun Roshi-authorized teacher, 1982). Long and short sesshin in the Sanbo Kyodan tradition; integrates Christian, Buddhist and Advaita strands.

places.name: Kanzeon Zendo
places.address: Kanzeon Zendo, Perumalmalai, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101, India
places.notes: Established 2022 by Ama Samy, who had founded Bodhi Zendo in 1996 and handed it to his successor Fr. Cyril Mathew. A distinct foundation in the same hill village; his teaching draws on both Sōtō and Rinzai.

places.name: Indozan Sogenji
places.lineage: Rinzai (One Drop Zen / Sōgen-ji; Shōdō Harada Rōshi)
places.notes: Rinzai monastery in the hills of Adilabad, established by Harada Rōshi's Indian student Bodhidhamma Osho; Shōdō Harada and Bodhidhamma became co-abbots on 25 August 2016. One of the four monasteries of the One Drop Zen community, with Sōgen-ji (Japan), Tahoma (USA) and Hokuozan (Germany). No street address is published.
